Presenting WAH RE DILDAR BANKE TUM PAR FULL VIDEO SONG from YEH DIL KISKO DOON movie starring Shashi Kapoor, Jeevan, Ragini in lead roles, released in 1963. The song is sung by Asha Bhosle and music is given by Iqbal Qureshi, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song: WAH RE DILDAR BANKE TUM PAR
Singer: ASHA BHOSLE
Music Director: IQBAL QURESHI
Lyricist: QAMAR JALALABADI
Asha Bhosle stated that she had sung over 12,000 songs and was officially acknowledged by the Guinness Book of World Records as the most recorded artist in music history.
